title: rivea choisyana
intro: Rivea choisyana, commonly known as Moonflower or Queen of the Night, is a species of flowering vine in the family Convolvulaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Rivea choisyana include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilator, which can help to protect against cell damage and improve blood flow. The bioactive constituents of Rivea choisyana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
